manual_review.notes: Running manual review instance; seeded through two ordinary development sandboxes and activate. The existing compiled browser evidence covers UUI resolution/continuation and deletions; that browser suite was not repeated for this launcher.
setup_failures_resolved: Workspace filesystem rejected Unix socket chmod; native /tmp instance storage is used.
Symlinked image roots failed gVisor mount confinement; prepared images are materialized once as native instance paths.
manual_review.persistence_limit: Instance state survives ordinary process restarts but is disposable under host /tmp cleanup. Prepared logins and demo state are not recreated by the launcher.

verification.parent_docs_left_unchanged: Production and package ownership is unchanged; only the opt-in analysis launcher and its handoff were added.
verification.broader_checks: No browser suite, benchmark, filesystem or concurrency qualification rerun for this handoff.
